d:
In this video I explore the real life of people living in Mogadishu, Somalia, a city often called one of the most dangerous capitals in the world. After the collapse of the government in 1991, Somalia faced civil war and the country was divided between different clans and groups.
Despite years of conflict and hardship, life in Mogadishu continues. I meet local Somali people and show how they live, work and survive in these conditions.
